lever: Foods with vitamin D (oily fish, eggs)
intervention: Eating foods that contain vitamin D
summary: Few foods contain much vitamin D. Oily fish and eggs contribute, but food alone rarely corrects a deficiency. In many countries most vitamin D comes from summer sunlight on the skin.
whyThisGrade: Little trial evidence that diet alone corrects low levels

studies.title: The 2011 report on dietary reference intakes for calcium and vitamin D from the Institute of Medicine: what clinicians need to know
